name: Bladeswift the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, Bladeswift the Elder's ancient spirit is honored in Darnassus. In the Cenarion Enclave, travelers seek his wisdom beneath the stars and a blessing tied to night elven tradition.

sections.title: A Spirit of the Boughs
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, revered ancestral spirits appear across Azeroth to share wisdom and bless travelers. In Darnassus, Bladeswift the Elder appears among the boughs of the Cenarion Enclave. This ancient spirit turns his gaze to the night sky and its mysteries, while the living face the trials of the present.

sections.title: Starlight and Ancient Truths
sections.body: Night elves have long looked to the heavens as reflections of Elune and signs of deeper truths. Bladeswift urges the wise and fortunate to seek answers among the stars. Those who honor him receive a Coin of Ancestry and join a ceremony that links the living with spirits of the past.

faq.answer: Elder Bladeswift is an ancestral night elf spirit honored during the Lunar Festival. In Darnassus, he offers guidance and blessings to travelers who honor their forebears.

faq.q: Where can Elder Bladeswift be found?
faq.answer: Elder Bladeswift can be found in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus, the night elf capital. He stands among its ponds and wooden walkways.

faq.q: What is the purpose of seeking out the elders?
faq.answer: Visiting the elders is a core tradition of the Lunar Festival. Paying respects to these ancient spirits across the world honors the wisdom of the past and earns Coins of Ancestry and seasonal goodwill.

faq.q: What does Bladeswift teach those who speak with him?
faq.answer: Bladeswift teaches seekers to look to the heavens. He says the countless stars hold truths and answers to earthly mysteries for those patient and wise enough to observe them.

faq.q: Can members of the Horde visit Elder Bladeswift?
faq.answer: Bladeswift resides deep inside Darnassus, an Alliance capital guarded by vigilant Sentinels. He welcomes any respectful traveler, though Horde visitors must brave hostile guards to reach him.

faq.q: Why is an elder present on Teldrassil if it is a new World Tree?
faq.answer: Teldrassil was grown only recently after the Third War, yet the spirits of Kaldorei ancestors are drawn to the living heart of their people. They appear near their kin to observe the festival.

angles.text: As a night elf, standing before Elder Bladeswift in Darnassus brings you close to your people's celestial heritage and devotion to the heavens.
As a druid, you share a deep cultural and spiritual duty to honor ancient spirits like Bladeswift as a steward of nature aligned with the Cenarion Circle.
As an Alliance hero, you can make a safe, easy, and peaceful pilgrimage to Elder Bladeswift inside Darnassus during the Lunar Festival.
